text:
sam: Heads-up — customer onboarding hit a weird case: our rerank/embedding pipeline returned duplicate item ids in the merged reply after an auth-refresh retry. TypeScript sampleapp silently overwrote the earlier vector leading to mis-ranks.

tori: duplicate ids? can you paste the captured merged body (redacted ids)?

sam: yup. outgoing batch (trimmed):
```json
{"items":[{"id":"x1","text":"pricing"},{"id":"x2","text":"limits"},{"id":"x3","text":"onboarding"}]}
```
merged response we captured (server appended partials):
```json
{"results":[{"id":"x1","vector":[0.1,0.2,...],"dim":1536},{"id":"x2","vector":[0.3,0.4,...],"dim":1536},{"id":"x1","vector":[0.15,0.25,...],"dim":1536}]}
```
Note the second chunk repeated id x1 (retry returned a re-computed embedding for x1). The TS helper built a Map by id and the second x1 overwrote the first. No error surfaced.

ishaan: interesting — server should not emit duplicate ids, but if it does client must detect it. How did the auth refresh happen? any 401 trace?

sam: log shows HTTP/2 stream multiplexing + 401 on the first sub-request, auth rotated, then retry for the remaining shard. Timestamps:
```
[12:01:03] req chunkA -> 200 (partial)
[12:01:03] req chunkB -> 401
[12:01:04] auth refresh
[12:01:04] req chunkB retry -> 200 (partial with x1 recomputed)
[12:01:04] runtime merged chunkA + chunkB by append
```
This gave duplicate x1.

tori: server merge should dedupe by id or attach a stable sequence. Platform-side ticket?

platform-bot: PLATFORM-1523 created: "Prevent duplicate ids in merged embedding responses; attach seq or dedupe on merge". ETA: rolling fix in next patch.

maddy: short-term client mitigation: TS helper should 1) detect duplicate ids in resp.results and error or prefer the earliest occurrence (not silent overwrite), 2) always assemble final array by mapping input ids to response entries and validate 1:1 correspondence, 3) validate dim and types. Example change:
```ts
const seen = new Set<string>();
for (const r of resp.results) {
  if (seen.has(r.id)) throw new Error(`duplicate id in response: ${r.id}`)
  seen.add(r.id)
}
const byId = new Map(resp.results.map(r => [r.id, r]));
return items.map(i => byId.get(i.id) ?? throwMissing(i.id));
```
This fails fast rather than silently mis-ranking.

ishaan: +1 to failing fast. Also add a CI conformance harness that simulates: a) appended partials with duplicate id, b) reorder, c) base64 fp16 path. Make sure SDKs behave consistently.

ts-sdk-bot: PR #7101 opened: "ts-embed-helper: detect duplicate ids, id-keyed assembly, dim/type normalization". Includes unit that simulates duplicate-id merge and expects an explicit error.

maddy: Other gotcha: some quantized shards returned embedding as base64 string in field "embedding" and dim as string. Helpers should coerce and reject ambiguous dims.

sam: For onboarding docs I added a note: "If you see mis-rankings after retries, check for duplicate ids in merged response. SDKs should detect duplicates and error loudly. Do not rely on response ordering." Also included a tiny snippet showing detection + id-keyed assembly.

tori: Good. Once PLATFORM-1523 lands we can relax client checks to warn instead of error, but for now fail-fast is safer. Also add the duplicate-id fuzz case to sampleapp CI.

platform-bot: PLATFORM-1523 updated: dedupe-on-merge implemented in canary; will also add X-Embedding-Format header to indicate numeric vs b64.

ishaan: I'll add cross-sdk conformance tests (TS, Go, Python, Java) that include duplicate-id, reorder, and quantized fixtures. We should ensure parity and a single defensive pattern in docs.

maddy: landed the TS PR with tests. QA added the duplicate-id fuzz to CI and it caught one other helper that silently took the last duplicate.

sam: thanks all — this was subtle but glad we caught it before it hit more customers.
